verification.method: Direct residual identity, with no division. For r>0 and sin(theta)>0, r*sin(theta)*exp(-r*cos(theta)) increases monotonically if cos<=0; if cos>0 it has maximum tan(theta)/e at r=1/cos(theta). This proves all zero/one/two-radius branches and the included double tangency at theta=atan(e). r=0 is excluded by residual -1.
